limitations: Explicit small parent-selected real BGT subset for packaging acceptance; not full-region coverage.

Derivative asset: Shapely/GEOS Douglas-Peucker simplification with preserve_topology=True at tolerance 0.05 metres (0 means geometrically unchanged); coordinates stay in projected metres and are not re-rounded.

Shared seam vertices are locked across neighbouring polygons (including holes and multi-polygon components) so original shared borders are retained exactly without buffering, enlargement or new connection lines; when seam safety cannot be proved the feature stays unchanged.

Isolated boundary point contacts (including mixed Point/LineString intersections) are locked on both neighbours; after simplification every bbox-intersecting neighbour pair is re-validated for newly shared interior area, uncovered shared seams and lost point contacts, and any feature whose safety cannot be shown is retained complete and unchanged (never buffered, repaired, dissolved, enlarged or connected anew).
Shared-boundary locking does not establish inter-feature network continuity; parents must independently test routes.
